base: eoc::CustomStatDefinitionComponent (Toolkit EoCShared.dll: VMT, FixedString +8, STDString +0x10, STDString +0x28; 0x40 bytes)
summary: Client copy of a custom stat definition (legacy HUB object with a virtual table), kept in sync by ecl::CustomStatsSystem::UpdateStatDefinition from CustomStatDefinitionSyncInfo messages (bg3.exe+0x1FF69B0, message 0xD7, 0x48-byte sync records). Custom stats are a DOS2 feature that BG3 still carries.

fields.name: VMT
fields.evidence: Destructor registered by bg3.exe+0x5FD290 is bg3.exe+0x6835D0 = call through the first pointer of the object (virtual destructor); EoCShared.dll eoc::CustomStatDefinitionComponent ctor writes its _vftable_ at +0; macOS ecl::CustomStatDefinitionComponent::~ writes PTR_..._CustomStatDefinitionComponent at +0.

fields.name: Id
fields.evidence: Assert text in EoCClient.dll+0xA405F0 ecl::CustomStatsSystem::UpdateStatDefinition: 'Id cannot be changed during updating stat definition' while comparing *(int*)(comp+8) with the sync info. bg3.exe+0x1FF69B0 compares comp+8 with the record's id before calling the move-assign bg3.exe+0x11CE600, which moves a FixedString at +8.

fields.name: Name
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x11CE600 (game move-assign) moves a 24-byte string at +0x10 with FUN_144122f50; EoCShared.dll eoc::CustomStatDefinitionComponent::Visit sends it as STDString. Name/Description from DOS2's CustomStatDefinitionComponent (Id, Name, Description) - order not proven.

fields.name: Description
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x11CE600 moves the second 24-byte string at +0x28; see Name.

fields.name: field_40
fields.evidence: Inside the registry size 0x50 (bg3.exe+0x5FD290 registers 0x500050) but not touched by the game move-assign or by the Toolkit/macOS eoc ctor/dtor (macOS default ctor stores only up to +0x40). Possibly ecl-only members of this build.

open_questions: +0x40..+0x50: 16 bytes inside the registry size that no function touches (the shared object is 0x40 bytes; macOS ecl::CustomStatDefinitionComponent has no members beyond it) - possibly registry padding.
Name vs Description order of the two strings (the Toolkit Visit sends them unnamed).
The creating function (HUB factory) was not found on the Windows side.
status_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
second_pass: Not settled: the update bg3.exe+0x1FF69B0 walks 0x48-byte sync records (entity + a 0x40-byte object at +8) and move-assigns only +8..+0x40 (bg3.exe+0x11CE600); the macOS ecl destructor (bg3_macos_x64+0x3450110) releases only the two strings and the FixedString, so nothing names +0x40..+0x50 on either side.
